title: Crystal River Boat Tours

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Experience a 2-hour Sunset Cruise through Crystal River and King’s Bay with Captain Wayne. Watch the golden light reflect off the water as you search for manatees, dolphins, and other wildlife. Learn about the area’s rich history while relaxing aboard a comfortable 20-foot pontoon boat for $250 for up to 4 guests,

blurb: Embark on a 2-hour boat tour through Crystal River and King’s Bay, guided by USCG Master Captain Wayne Bodley. Spot manatees, dolphins, alligators, and native birds while learning about the area’s history. Enjoy a comfortable 20-foot pontoon boat and explore Florida’s serene waterways for just $50 per person. Book your unforgettable wildlife adventure
